applies_to: cool (post-flame) soot carbon constituent, c_carbon inventory at phi(T)~0 (SS3.4/SS4.3)
carrier_note: Draft JSON carrier. Final adoption per FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md SS8 requires re-encoding as a RISE-CBOR64-v1 byte string; the adopted record ID is SHA-256 of those exact CBOR bytes. The draft_record_id here covers only this JSON payload.

consistency_check_total_anchor.arithmetic: MAC(633) = 7.5*(550/633) = 6.52 m2/g; with omega=0.25: k_ext = 6.52/0.75 = 8.69 m2/g. Implied omega from anchor: 1 - 6.52/8.7 = 0.251 = B&B central SSA. PASSES to <1%.
consistency_check_total_anchor.mixture_dilution: k_total = f_EC*8.7 + (1-f_EC)*k_cond(3.30 Mie) requires f_EC >= 0.80 to stay inside [7.6, 9.8]. Chen et al. 2007 (ES&T 41:4317, Table 2 p.4322) flaming ponderosa pine wood: EC/PM ~ 0.80, EC/TC ~ 0.84 at MCE 0.99 -> CONSISTENT. Field-plume BC fractions 5-9% (Reid 2005 II p.803-805) are a different (smoldering-weighted) regime where the flaming-only anchor does not apply.
consistency_check_total_anchor.statement: SS4.3: constituent presets must be consistent with M&C 8.7+/-1.1 m2/g @633 total post-flame extinction for wood-class fuels

gaps: IR absorption for SS3.5 Kirchhoff emission: B&B explicitly makes no statement outside 400-700nm; the record needs the C&C dispersion (or another source) for thermal wavelengths - couples to the E(m) record's >6.4um verification
omega/g wavelength dependence beyond 633nm: assemble from RDG-FA once morphology record adopted
M&C body (per-fuel spread, coverage factor): paywalled - owner library pull
derivative enclosures for interpolation (SS12 Q2): to be generated at record-freeze time from the adopted table

phi_T_partition.consistency_requirement: the hot-soot and cool-carbon records must carry bit-identical phi_T fields at record freeze (one optical record in the final SS8 CBOR encoding)
phi_T_partition.form: phi(T) = smoothstep over T in [700, 900] K: 0 below, 1 above. FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md SS3.4 says 'smoothstep' unqualified; the cubic Hermite 3t^2-2t^3 (C1) is the assumed canonical form - if the SS3.5 backward-Euler solver requires C2 (smootherstep), that is a design-loop question, not an implementation choice
phi_T_partition.provenance: FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md SS3.4 (r45+; lines ~807-808): design-owned closure parameter of the derived hot/cool carbon partition c_hot = phi(T)*c_carbon. NOT a literature constant - its authority is the design decision itself. SS8 requires the phi(T) band in the versioned optical record; this field closes that gap in the draft layer (added 2026-08-06 at the implementation agent's provenance stop).

traps_flagged: Do NOT derive MAC from the refractive index via Mie/RDG: B&B SS7.5 pp.51-52 shows ~30% underprediction; pin measured MAC+SSA directly
The +/-1.2 (1sigma) and +/-1.1 (95% expanded) are different statistics
